SMC contractile gene expression and, thus differentiation, is under direct transcriptional control by the… 34071621 nuclear-pten-functions-as-an-essential-regulator-of-srf-dependent-transcription-to-control-smooth-muscle-differentiation nuclear pten functions as essential regulator srf dependent Vascular disease progression is associated with marked changes in vascular smoo Nuclear PTEN functions as an essential regulator of SRF-dependent transcription to control smooth muscle differentiation Vascular disease progression is associated with marked changes in vascular smooth muscle cell (SMC) phenotype and function. SMC contractile gene expression and, thus differentiation, is under direct transcriptional control by the transcription factor, serum response factor (SRF); however, the mechanisms dynamically regulating SMC phenotype are not fully defined. Here we report that the lipid and protein phosphatase, PTEN, has a novel role in the nucleus by functioning as an indispensible regulator with SRF to maintain the differentiated SM phenotype.
